name: Lo-fi found image
summary: A low-resolution photo of an ordinary place, scaled up so that the JPEG blocks show. It looks like a lost or half-remembered picture.
how: Scale a photo of 320 to 640px up to the full frame with no smoothing.
Shift the colour by 10% to 20% to yellow-green or magenta.
Add noise of 5% to 10% and a vignette of 20%.
Add one wrong detail, such as a black void or a faceless figure.

origin.note: Online groups on Weirdcore and Liminalspace collect poor photos of empty rooms and playgrounds.

adoptions.via: Weirdcore posts use poor photos of empty places, with red text and black voids.
Dreamcore images use the same soft, degraded photos, with pastel colour and bloom.
